 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Marcus Thuram and Pio Esposito will lead the line for Inter against Como in the absence of Lautaro Martinez, as Cesc Fabregas again turns to Nico Paz, Martin Baturina and Tasos Douvikas in attack in Serie A on Sunday evening.
 This is a real battle at the top end of the Serie A table, as third-place Inter will be hoping to move within one point of the lead with a victory this evening, while Como, fifth ahead of kick-off, could overtake their opponents into third if they walk away with victory.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement It kicks off at 17.00 GMT (18.00 CET).
 You can follow the action as it unfolds on the Football Italia Liveblog. 
 ROTTERDAM, NETHERLANDS – NOVEMBER 03: Piotr Zielinski of FC Internazionale Milano celebrates with teammates after scoring his team's third goal during the UEFA Champions League 2026/27 League Phase MD4 match between Feyenoord and FC Internazionale Milano at De Kuip on November 03, 2026 in Rotterdam, Netherlands. (Photo by Lars Baron/Getty Images)
 Both sides are coming in off the back of midweek Champions League victories: Hosts Inter defeated Feyenoord 3-0 in Rotterdam whilst the visitors smashed Lens 9-1 in the largest away victory in the competition's history.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement In terms of Serie A form, Inter will be hoping to get back to winning ways after a disappointing 3-1 Derby della Madonnina defeat against rivals Milan last weekend. They had won four in a row before the Milan defeat. Como, meanwhile, beat Venezia last weekend in what was their fourth consecutive league victory.
 FLORENCE, ITALY – OCTOBER 18: Anastasios Douvikas of Como 1907 celebrates after scoring a goal during the Serie A match between ACF Fiorentina and Como 1907 at Stadio Artemio Franchi on October 18, 2026 in Florence, Italy. (Photo by Gabriele Maltinti/Getty Images)
 Inter will be able to call upon Alessandro Bastoni again after his recent suspension and also have Curtis Jones and John Stones available for selection. The English pair start among the substitutes against Como.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Captain and leading goalscorer Lautaro Martinez remains out injured, as does Luis Henrique.
 Pio Esposito and Marcus Thuram are selected to lead the line in San Siro.
 Como have a longer injury list that includes Moise Kean, Jesus Rodriguez, Assane Diao, Jayden Addai and Trevoh Chalobah.
 The Como attack is again led by Tasos Douvikas, Nico Paz and Lucas Da Cunha, with Martin Baturina called back into the starting line-up after coming off the bench against Lens midweek. Robert Sanchez is preferred to Jean Butez in goal.
 Inter vs. Como: Confirmed line-ups
 COMO, ITALY – APRIL 12: Como 1907 coach Cesc Fabregas and FC Internazionale coach Cristian Chivu look on during the Serie A match between Como 1907 and FC Internazionale at Giuseppe Sinigaglia Stadium on April 12, 2026 in Como, Italy. (Photo by Marco Luzzani/Getty Images)
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Inter (3-5-2): J. Martinez; Akanji, Bastoni, Carlos Augusto; Spence, Barella, Calhanoglu, Zielinski, Dimarco; Esposito, Thuram.
 Como (4-2-3-1): Sanchez; Couto, Ramon, Kempf, Valle; Milla, Ricci; Da Cunha, Paz, Baturina; Douvikas.
